title: SCA Minhag of the Week 249: "Syrian Weddings: Marching, Facing the Crowd, Besamim Blessing and More"

chapters.title: Wedding Marches and Seating
chapters.about: Marching procedures, flower girls, parents, and the bridal throne in Aleppo.

chapters.title: Facing the Crowd
chapters.about: The position of the bride and groom and facing the people instead of the hechal.

chapters.title: The Tallit Canopy
chapters.about: Differences in the tallit canopy between Aleppo, Damascus, and Brooklyn.

chapters.title: Besamim Blessing
chapters.about: The blessing on besamim during the wedding according to Rambam and Abudraham.

chapters.title: Ancient Wedding Song
chapters.about: The traditional song sung during the ceremony and old manuscripts from Aleppo.

summary: Mr. Mosseri discusses traditional Syrian wedding customs from Aleppo and Damascus, comparing them with practices in Brooklyn. He covers topics such as the wedding march, the bridal throne and seating arrangements, the direction the couple faces, the use of a tallit canopy, and the blessing on besamim.
questions: How did wedding processions in Aleppo compare to modern ones?
Where did the bride sit or stand during the wedding ceremony in Aleppo?
Did the bride and groom face the hechal or the crowd during the ceremony?
How was the tallit canopy used in Aleppo compared to Brooklyn and Damascus?
When was the blessing on besamim recited during the wedding?
